facts.fact: The Prime Minister inaugurated the new State Data Center on 29 July 2015 (event date taken from the publication date); the document says the country can offer data storage, processing and website hosting to national and international institutions from it, and urges attracting ECOWAS, banks and universities to host data there.

facts.fact: The Prime Minister inaugurated the new Data Center (Centro de Dados) 'do Estado' of Cabo Verde on 29 July 2015 (publication date, no other given); the document calls it the State's data centre, with NOSI, the government's e-governance body, explaining it, and says it can offer storage, processing and website hosting to national and international institutions.
facts.system: Praia state data centre (Data Center do Estado de Cabo Verde)

facts.fact: The document states the new State Data Center is the nerve centre of all Government communication, of the e-governance platform and of all public administration services, storing and processing their data; it is run by NOSI. Event date taken from the publication date, 29 July 2015.
